name: Scam call · Pressure and payment
description: What the caller does in phone and tech-support scams: authority, urgency, secrecy, payment and access. Custom items are unvalidated wording.

detectors.name: Asks for secrecy
detectors.what: the speaker tells the other person not to tell anyone or to keep the call secret
detectors.example: Do not tell your bank or your family about this call.

detectors.name: Claims authority
detectors.what: the speaker claims to represent a bank, government agency, or trusted company
detectors.example: This is the fraud department at your bank.

detectors.name: Asks for payment
detectors.what: the speaker asks for money, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or a payment code
detectors.example: Go to the store and buy four gift cards.

detectors.name: Asks for access
detectors.what: the speaker asks the other person to install software, share their screen, or read out a code or password
detectors.example: Please install this program so I can see your screen.

detectors.name: Gives orders
detectors.what: the speaker tells the other person exactly what to do next, step by step
detectors.example: Now click the blue button and enter the number.

detectors.name: Reassures
detectors.what: the speaker reassures the other person to keep them calm and cooperating
detectors.example: Don't worry sir, I will take care of everything for you.
